consumer.use: Decide whether the terminally paper-passed S1-R2 sampling rule plus unchanged S0-R3 Outcome Case semantics can be applied prospectively to the first three real post-activation Operator-Intake births without source-selection, capture or authority failure.

decision_target.question: Can the unchanged S1-R2 canonical-identity/fixed-slot natural-source contract bind the first three real post-activation Bureau Operator-Intake births prospectively, with zero sampling/capture failures and acceptable handling cost?

intervention.name: prospective S1-R2 natural three-slot capture
intervention.description: After the external work-blind Codex finding github:heimgewebe/vibe-lab#353:discussion_r3819573067, start exactly one controller-owned orchestration job within 900 GitHub-server seconds and before publishing the final author head. That same Bureau-blind job publishes the exact head, freezes its canonical PR diff, automatically requests/reconciles the required current-head Codex review, waits for green CI and merges the exact PR with merge_method=merge on the first all-gates-PASS observation. It then verifies exact merge identity, preserves monotonic heartbeat continuity with no gap above 5 seconds, anchors exactly one complete authoritative Bureau SQLite journal snapshot in the closed 300-305 second post-integration window, freezes its high-water event id, and only then admits the first three Operator-Intake identity births strictly above that watermark for unchanged S1-R2/S0-R3 capture.

control_condition.description: Exactly three already frozen S0-R3 paper-semantic controls used previously by S1: R3-02 create-then-mutate, R3-04 pure prerequisite then distinct transition, and R3-08 unresolved subject equivalence. They are semantic benchmarks only and never natural evidence.

treatment_condition.description: Exactly the first three canonical Operator-Intake identity births whose exact identity-first event ids are strictly above the frozen authoritative Bureau activation watermark produced by the single externally triggered, continuity-valid orchestration job, under unchanged S1-R2 sequence-before-naturalness semantics, permanently assigned to S1R2-N01, S1R2-N02 and S1R2-N03 without replacement or backfill.

measurement.method: The external trigger is GitHub Codex discussion_r3819573067 at 2026-08-20T07:42:09Z. GitHub-server Date must show orchestration-job start within 900 seconds. The job is armed before author-head publication and neither controller nor job may inspect Bureau candidate/journal content until the one activation snapshot. The same job publishes the exact head, freezes exact base/head/canonical PR diff, automatically requests and reconciles the required current-head Codex semantic review, waits for all required CI checks and exact self-review evidence, and issues one expected-SHA merge_method=merge request on the first all-gates-PASS poll. It then requires first parent exactly reviewed_base, second parent exactly reviewed_head, reviewed_head ancestry and merge-tree identity with reviewed_head; it records no monotonic heartbeat gap above 5 seconds and anchors its only Bureau SQLite snapshot at 300-305 monotonic seconds after exact integration verification. Failed/restarted/replaced jobs or later snapshots cannot activate. Wall clocks never decide cohort membership; only identity_first_event.event_id > the single immutable watermark is eligible.
measurement.success: The externally triggered pre-publication orchestration job starts within 900 GitHub-server seconds; publishes/reviews/merges the exact tuple without Bureau observation or later controller timing; the required current-head Codex settlement has zero material findings; all CI and exact-head self-review gates pass; the resulting merge has first parent exactly reviewed_base, second parent exactly reviewed_head, reviewed_head ancestry and reviewed-head-tree identity; no orchestration heartbeat gap exceeds 5 seconds; the single snapshot anchor lies in 300-305 monotonic seconds and freezes one immutable high-water event id; then exactly three slots strictly above that watermark are consumed in canonical order with zero source/binding/review/authority/backfill failures, median capture effort <=600 seconds, and at least two definitive non-D0 C/S/B/E/T bindings.
measurement.falsification: Reject before activation on missed external-trigger deadline, author-head publication before orchestration arming, any Bureau candidate/journal observation before snapshot, manual/delayed review request or merge outside the job, any review/CI/self-review failure or ambiguity, head/base/diff drift, ordered merge-parent mismatch, ancestry or merge-tree mismatch, squash/rebase/cherry-pick or unreviewed conflict content, job restart/replacement, heartbeat gap >5 seconds, snapshot anchor outside 300-305 seconds, failed/repeated/incomplete snapshot, missing/mutable watermark, wall-clock cohort selection, any activation/selection degree of freedom, or any new productive authority. After activation reject on source-independence/capture failure, changed watermark/slot/classification, sequence/backfill violation, material terminal-review disagreement, authority violation or median effort >600 seconds.

cost_metric.method: Measure each slot from observer capture start to freeze/stop. Exclude productive implementation and reviewer runtime.
